name: Lipschitz Pruning
definition: A hierarchical pruning algorithm that reduces the number of active nodes in a smooth CSG tree for a specific region of space (e.g., a grid cell), outputting a pruned tree equivalent to the full tree within that region. It relies on the 1-Lipschitz property of the distance function.
summary: Lipschitz Pruning is a hierarchical algorithm that simplifies smooth CSG trees for specific spatial regions by exploiting the 1-Lipschitz property of distance functions, eliminating the need for bounding boxes while guaranteeing distance exactness.
